meta.defaultDescription: KAPU is a neighborhood café and cocktail bar in Kypseli and Kallithea, Athens — coffee and bakery by day, tiki-influenced cocktails by night.

home.heroSub: One neighborhood corner. Coffee by day, cocktails after dark — same place, different light.
home.dayBody: Fresh brew, soft cookies, sandwiches and sweets — the KAPU that opens the day, mint walls and bougainvillea light.
home.locationsBody: Kypseli and Kallithea are two real places, not two copies of the same page.
home.nightBody: Tiki glassware, signature cocktails invented in-house, and a room that gets a little more intimate once the sun goes down.
home.orderBody: KAPU delivers through Wolt and efood, and Box where confirmed — pick your platform.
home.finalVisitBody: Two corners of Athens, one KAPU. Find directions, hours, and a way to say hi.
